preregistration.hypothesis: On L4 the frozen objective saturates (4/4 train walking, validity 1 inside the gates) and rewards speed up to 0.4 m/s, so the submitted designs sit near the walking gates (15/16 robust, 19/24 validation). Ranking candidates by walking, then the paired-displacement constraint against the faulty robot, then the walking-gate margin raises validation walking to >= 20/24 while keeping verified displacement.
preregistration.primary_outcome: FULL_RECOVERY under the unchanged full_recovery_v1, per episode
preregistration.unit: replicate pair (shared bench noise seed): technical replicates of plant-CMA stochasticity on one robot instance
preregistration.primary_test: DO1-L4: exact one-sided McNemar (sign) test on discordant pairs, do1 FULL vs frozen FULL, alpha 0.05
preregistration.success: p <= 0.05, which with 5 pairs requires all 5 pairs discordant in favour of do1 (p = 0.031); an instance-specific finding about this robot and budget, not a rate over robots
preregistration.suggestive: every discordant pair favours do1 but p > 0.05 (e.g. 4 for, 0 against: p = 0.0625): reported as suggestive and inconclusive, never as a demonstrated improvement
preregistration.no_improvement_observed: no discordant pair favours do1: no evidence of improvement on this instance at this budget; with 5 technical replicates this is NOT a falsification of the objective
preregistration.otherwise: inconclusive at this budget (mixed discordant pairs); reported, no follow-up run without approval
preregistration.pilot_DO1-L4-r0: exploratory, one pair, no hypothesis test: FULL status, validation k/24, verdict and median paired displacement per arm, submitted and checked designs, per-candidate DO-1 components, budget split
secondary: paired validation walking k/24 (do1 - frozen) per replicate, sign of the 5 differences
validation verdict and median paired displacement (do1 must stay VERIFIED_IMPROVEMENT)
train-seed margin, median paired diff and feasibility of each submitted and checked design
robust16 and robust displacement of each checked design; mapped P(FULL); plant/twin rollouts
preregistration.interpretation_limits: technical replicates of plant-CMA stochasticity on one instance; not a rate over robots
preregistration.null_wording: No verified recovery was found under the tested intervention, optimizer configuration and computational budget.

phase_preregistration.study: W4: exploratory cross-family pilot, two development instances chosen by the pre-declared rule (stored A1e6 PARTIAL with walking-only failure, at least one stored plant repair, one body/mass and one controller family, highest stored walking count, ties by lowest base id)
phase_preregistration.runs: B1 r0 frozen, B1 r0 do1, C1 r0 frozen, C1 r0 do1
phase_preregistration.gates: frozen r0 reproduces the stored A1e6 record exactly; do1 r0 matches the stored pre-hook prefix; equal pre-hook fingerprints; hook once; verification complete; do1 exposure recorded (NOT_EXPOSED continues)
phase_preregistration.analysis: descriptive per instance and arm: status, validation k/24, verdict and median paired displacement, confirmation, plant/twin use, which recovery gates changed. No hypothesis test, no pooling with L4, no family- or population-level claim; cases were selected on the baseline's partial failure, so regression to the mean is possible
phase_preregistration.null_wording: No verified recovery was found under the tested intervention, optimizer configuration and computational budget.
